description: This file provides a wrapper API around the `flutter_local_notifications` package for scheduling and displaying local notifications in a Flutter application. It includes initialization, notification display, and scheduling functionalities, as well as handling notification taps via a stream.

classes.name: NotificationApi
classes.description: A wrapper class providing static methods to initialize, show, and schedule local notifications, and to handle notification responses via a stream.

methods.name: showSheduleNotification
methods.description: Schedules a notification to be shown at a specified future DateTime, considering timezone.
